title: Word motions
intro: w jumps to the start of the next word, b to the start of the previous one, e to the end of the current word. Punctuation counts as its own word. Counts work here too.

levels.title: Next word
levels.brief: Move to the start of quick. w jumps forward one word.

levels.title: Three words
levels.brief: Move to the start of fox. Use a count with w.

levels.title: Word end
levels.brief: Move to the last letter of jump. e jumps to the end of the word.

levels.title: Back
levels.brief: Move to the start of three. b jumps back one word.

levels.title: Punctuation counts
levels.brief: Move to the b of bar. The dot is a word of its own, so it takes two w presses, or one count.
levels.hint: foo, then the dot, then bar.

levels.title: First non-blank
levels.brief: Move to the i of indented. ^ jumps to the first non-blank character, which is usually what you want instead of 0.
levels.hint: 0 would land on the first space.

levels.title: Delete at the word
levels.brief: Fix thhe. Jump to the word, step onto the extra h, delete it with x.
levels.hint: w lands on the t. One l reaches the first h.

levels.title: End of a longer word
levels.brief: Move to the last letter of betagamma using e with a count.
levels.hint: The first e reaches the end of alpha.
